scientific_integrity.evidence: Standalone exhaustive state/backtracking and independent matching-based verification, with complete colourings, adjacency, shortest-path profiles and odd-cycle witnesses.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion concerns only GP(10,3) with three individually named colours and a single alternating-cycle swap.
The exhaustive proof is finite and does not imply an all-graph theorem.
A matching exact classification might exist in older or otherwise unindexed literature.

title: Seven Kempe sectors of the Desargues graph: a mixed-parity decomposition
